title: OPERATOR
notes: About 4 hours: a house raid against AI bots, then online on multiplayer servers. Runs really smooth: steady 55 FPS (capped) at 1080p with DLSS (MetalFX) Quality, Medium preset. First launch takes a few minutes. Night vision and aiming are slightly blurry by design; a narrower window makes them sharp. Mods via BepInEx 6 IL2CPP work with the winhttp=n,b override. Full setup guide: https://www.nexusmods.com/operator/mods/247
